last_evaluation.summary: The repo no longer contains development-automation code. The game, contribution intake, round lifecycle and documentation remain. Frozen contributions can now be exported for the devion workseed project, and the backend builds and passes its tests.

assessment.requirements: All the removal requirements are delivered. The worker module, the execution backend, the execution/approve/retry routes, the worker config keys and the admin execution panel are gone. A frozen-contribution export for the workseed handoff is defined and documented. The kept areas (game, frontend game UI, content, contribution intake, round lifecycle, docs) are intact.
assessment.business: The project is now just the game and community-contribution flow. Coding agents and the pipeline that ran them no longer live here, and player contributions are handed off to devion workseed. There is no remaining cost or functional gap for players or maintainers.
assessment.technical: The backend compiles and every remaining test package passes. Guard tests check that the removed packages, routes, config fields and UI panel stay absent. An old worker section in a config file is ignored without an error. I did not re-run the frontend tests. The Verify evidence reports passing frontend and documentation checks. The residual risk is low.

message: The repo no longer contains development-automation code. The game, contribution intake, round lifecycle and documentation remain. Frozen contributions can now be exported for the devion workseed project, and the backend builds and passes its tests.
